historical_result.preceding_snapshot_error: Step 3 returned a destroyed-execution-context snapshot error despite tool-wrapper success; step 5 returned a complete New Issue snapshot before the step-6 fill timeout.

diagnostic_contract.action_scope: frozen actions 1-5, then read-only input geometry; a separate diagnostic scroll and frozen step-6 fill without issue submission

reviewed_cause.mechanism_zh: 历史 1.1.3 在新建 Issue 页已加载完成时，标题输入框存在、未禁用且样式可见，但布局矩形持续为零，导致原轨迹第 6 步的 :visible 填写超时。同版本同页仅滚动一次就使矩形同步变为 977×34，随后原封不动的第 6 步填写成功并读回预期值。故障在页面布局几何刷新路径，而非输入框缺失或第 3 步快照错误；官方 1.1.6 和固定候选在页面加载完成时均直接给出非零矩形。
reviewed_cause.mechanism_en: On the historical 1.1.3 New Issue page after load completion, the title input existed, was enabled and had visible computed style, but retained a zero-area rectangle, causing the original step-6 :visible fill to time out. In the same build and page, one scroll synchronously changed the rectangle to 977×34; the unchanged frozen step-6 fill then succeeded and read back the expected value. The defect lies in geometry refresh, not a missing input or the step-3 snapshot error. Official 1.1.6 and the fixed candidate gave the input nonzero geometry after load completion.

scope_limit: The historical Moli 1.1.3 image was tested against the current Rainbond site, not the original local deployment. The exact source commit between 1.1.3 and 1.1.6 was not isolated. The scroll-and-fill probe did not submit an issue or replace the historical official verdict.
